name: URY desk order list
describe: URY desk Orders page as the POS Invoice list: 30px rows, status indicator badges from pos_invoice_list.js (Paid, Consolidated, Draft, Unpaid, Partly Paid), Customer / Company / Grand Total columns, quick filters from the doctype json.
